title: 90% Neural Overlap
visualDescription: Educational split-scene infographic: LEFT SIDE shows side profile of human head with brain visible through transparent skull, neural pathways lighting up in bright blue-white electricity as person physically plays piano keys with hands visible at bottom. RIGHT SIDE shows identical head profile with same neural pathways lighting up almost identically (90% overlap highlighted) but person's eyes are closed in peaceful concentration, hands still, imagining playing piano. A subtle '90%' statistic floats between the two sides. Clean modern medical illustration style merged with cinematic lighting
style: scientific medical illustration, clean modern infographic, dramatic lighting, brain scan aesthetic, deep blue and white color palette, 8K resolution, photorealistic brain detail
textOverlay: Your Brain Can't Tell The Difference
purpose: Visualize the 90% neural overlap between doing and imagining

title: The Piano Study
visualDescription: Educational infographic showing famous piano visualization experiment: Three horizontal lanes like a race track. TOP LANE: Person physically practicing at piano with musical notes and brain icon showing growth, labeled 'Physical Practice'. MIDDLE LANE: Person sitting peacefully with eyes closed, thought bubble showing piano keys, brain icon also showing growth (nearly equal to top), labeled 'Mental Practice Only'. BOTTOM LANE: Person doing nothing, brain icon showing no change, labeled 'Control Group'. All three lanes converging to show brain scan results comparison on right side. Clean scientific study visualization
style: clean infographic design, research study aesthetic, warm educational colors, comparison chart style, professional data visualization, 8K resolution
purpose: Illustrate the Harvard piano study comparing physical vs mental practice
